outcome: Fetal heart rate (FHR) variability (baseline, accelerations/decelerations, long-term variability, short-term variability)
Ability of clinical parameters to distinguish between normal and abnormal fetal outcomes
cohort: The study included recordings collected from 60 patients with physiological and complicated pregnancies.
finding: Abdominal FECG, considered as an alternative to the ultrasound approach, does not change the interpretation of the FHR signal during both visual assessment and automated analysis, despite inconsistencies in deceleration patterns and overestimation of STV and LTV indices.
